name: loop_strategy_compare_30seed_v2
notes: Re-run of the 30-seed comparison with the §7 P0/P1 fixes in place: ledger pred_gbsa is now index-correct, OOD uses the pre-acquisition training set, and the driver refuses to report success when any seed/strategy/round is missing (completeness.json).
